# overlake.bio

> overlake.bio is a research initiative and think tank using agentic AI and biomolecular tools to advance healthy lifespan extension and resilience under extreme conditions.

Most of this work descends from one claim — the Delocalized Entropy Aging
Theorem: that the hallmarks of aging are emergent phenomena secondary to
chemical crosslinking of the extracellular matrix, making ECM stiffening a
causative upstream agent rather than a downstream consequence.

## Agent skill

- [SKILL.md](https://overlake.bio/SKILL.md): drop-in agent skill covering this whole body of work. Reference files are fetched from https://overlake.bio/skill/overlake-bio/references/ as needed.
- [Bundle (zip)](https://overlake.bio/skill/overlake-bio.zip): the same skill with all reference files included, for offline use.

## Pages

- [About](https://overlake.bio/about.html): About overlake.bio: a research initiative and think tank applying agentic AI and biomolecular design across a multi-project pipeline toward healthy lifespan extension.
- [Projects](https://overlake.bio/projects.html): Overlake's research pipeline: the Spacefarer phenome, enzyme engineering for crosslinked collagen turnover, the ECM Aging Atlas, AGE-degrading enzymes, and ribosome glycation.
- [Publications](https://overlake.bio/publications.html): Papers, preprints, and proposals from overlake.bio on aging, the extracellular matrix, glycation, and translation fidelity.
- [Media](https://overlake.bio/media.html): Hackathons, prizes and programmes overlake.bio has taken part in, what came of them, the decks we presented, and the press that covered it.
- [Blog](https://overlake.bio/blog.html): Thoughts, updates, and insights from the overlake.bio research initiative.
